/* AppLeave01Mapper.selectExpiringSoon */ SELECT COUNT(*) AS targetCount , MIN(G.AVAIL_TO_DATE) AS nearestExpiryYmd , DATEDIFF( STR_TO_DATE(MIN(G.AVAIL_TO_DATE), '%Y%m%d') , STR_TO_DATE(#{ param.todayYmd }, '%Y%m%d') ) AS daysUntilExpiry , SUM(G.GRANT_DAYS - G.USED_DAYS) AS totalRemainingDays FROM TB_USER_LEAVE_GRANT G WHERE G.CMPNY_CD = #{ param.cmpnyCd } AND G.USER_CD = #{ param.userCd } AND G.STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND G.EXPIRE_YN = 'N' AND G.DEL_YN = 'N' AND (G.GRANT_DAYS - G.USED_DAYS) > 0
AND NOT (G.GRANT_REASON LIKE '[가불]%' AND G.AVAIL_FROM_DATE > #{ param.todayYmd }) AND G.AVAIL_TO_DATE BETWEEN #{ param.todayYmd } AND DATE_FORMAT( DATE_ADD(STR_TO_DATE(#{ param.todayYmd }, '%Y%m%d'), INTERVAL 30 DAY) , '%Y%m%d' )

/* AppLeave01Mapper.selectUser */ SELECT U.USER_NM AS userNm , U.HIRE_DATE AS hireDate , IFNULL(( SELECT SUM(C.CREDIT_MONTHS) FROM TB_USER_SERVICE_CREDIT C WHERE C.CMPNY_CD = U.CMPNY_CD AND C.USER_CD = U.USER_CD AND C.USE_YN = 'Y' ), 0) AS serviceCreditMonths FROM TB_USER U WHERE U.CMPNY_CD = #{ param.cmpnyCd } AND U.USER_CD = #{ param.userCd }

/* AppLeave01Mapper.selectAppliedLeaveTypes */ SELECT T.LEAVE_CD AS leaveCd , T.LEAVE_NM AS leaveNm , T.MAX_APLY_DAYS AS maxAplyDays , IFNULL(( SELECT SUM(U.LEAVE_DAYS) FROM TB_USER_LEAVE_USE U WHERE U.CMPNY_CD = T.CMPNY_CD AND U.USER_CD = #{userCd} AND U.LEAVE_CD = T.LEAVE_CD AND U.LEAVE_STATUS = 'CONFIRMED' AND U.DEL_YN = 'N' AND U.START_DATE >= #{fiscalStartYmd} AND U.START_DATE < #{fiscalEndYmdExclusive} ), 0) AS usedDays FROM TB_LEAVE_TYPE_MGMT T WHERE T.CMPNY_CD = #{cmpnyCd} AND T.LEAVE_TYPE = '01' AND T.USE_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY T.LEAVE_NO ASC, T.LEAVE_CD ASC

/* AppLeave01Mapper.selectHourlyUsedMinutesSplit */ SELECT IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN U.USE_UNIT_TYPE IN ('02', '03', '04') AND U.START_DATE <= #{todayYmd} THEN U.LEAVE_MINUTES ELSE 0 END), 0) AS pastMinutes , IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN U.USE_UNIT_TYPE IN ('02', '03', '04') AND U.START_DATE > #{todayYmd} THEN U.LEAVE_MINUTES ELSE 0 END), 0) AS plannedMinutes , IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN U.USE_UNIT_TYPE = '01' AND U.START_DATE <= #{todayYmd} THEN U.LEAVE_DAYS ELSE 0 END), 0) AS halfDayPastDays , IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN U.USE_UNIT_TYPE = '01' AND U.START_DATE > #{todayYmd} THEN U.LEAVE_DAYS ELSE 0 END), 0) AS halfDayPlannedDays FROM TB_USER_LEAVE_USE U JOIN TB_USER_LEAVE_GRANT G ON G.CMPNY_CD = U.CMPNY_CD AND G.GRANT_ID = U.GRANT_ID AND G.STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND G.EXPIRE_YN = 'N' AND G.DEL_YN = 'N' AND NOT (G.GRANT_REASON LIKE '[가불]%' AND G.AVAIL_FROM_DATE > #{todayYmd}) WHERE U.CMPNY_CD = #{cmpnyCd} AND U.USER_CD = #{userCd} AND U.USE_UNIT_TYPE IN ('01', '02', '03', '04') AND U.LEAVE_STATUS = 'CONFIRMED' AND U.DEL_YN = 'N'
